laya_question: Given this task and the model profile, is {label} suited to completing it on the first attempt without rework? Profile: {suited_for}

laya_criteria.A: yes, likely to complete the task on the first attempt without rework
laya_criteria.B: no, likely to fail or need rework

laya_difficulty.question: How demanding is this task for an AI coding agent?

levels.trivial: single read, lookup or format conversion with a checkable output
levels.mechanical: pattern-following edit or small script with a test to run
levels.routine: day-to-day coding with a clear scope
levels.complex: several modules, design judgment or a non-local cause
levels.open: long, ambiguous or autonomous work where errors are costly

claude.label: Haiku at low effort
claude.suited_for: well-specified one-shot or batch work with a cheap check: extraction, classification, format conversion, renames, boilerplate; no search, no decisions, nothing ambiguous or critical

claude.label: Haiku at medium effort
claude.suited_for: short well-specified task with known tools: find call sites, a small script or function with unit tests, a query or command from a clear spec

claude.label: Haiku at high effort
claude.suited_for: localized problem that needs care in one area: a bug with a stack trace, a small diff review, edge-case tests, a pattern-following multi-file change with a test to run

claude.label: Sonnet at medium effort
claude.suited_for: day-to-day coding with a clear scope: a feature, endpoint or end-to-end script with tests, integrating a few components

claude.label: Sonnet at high effort
claude.suited_for: clear scope where verification matters: failure handling, concurrency or edge cases across a few components; reproduce before fixing

claude.label: Opus at medium effort
claude.suited_for: stronger reasoning with a defined goal: a complete feature or pipeline in real code, several modules, design judgment, long cohesive change

claude.label: Opus at high effort
claude.suited_for: errors are costly or the cause is not local: change across many modules, debugging with several hypotheses, security review, long agentic session

claude.label: Opus at xhigh effort
claude.suited_for: deep architecture, concurrency, numerical or ML problem with long-term trade-offs; an open problem

claude.label: Opus at max effort
claude.suited_for: hard problem worked through unattended after Opus at xhigh fell short; diminishing returns and prone to overthinking

claude.label: Fable at low effort
claude.suited_for: step that failed on Opus: the strongest judgment in a short answer, such as a likely root cause, a second opinion on a critical design or a precise spec for cheaper executors

claude.label: Fable at medium effort
claude.suited_for: non-trivial algorithm or precision engineering: correct edge cases, output identical to a reference, root-cause investigation, long autonomous work

claude.label: Fable at high effort
claude.suited_for: long autonomous work where subtle bugs are costly: race conditions, rewriting critical code with proven output equivalence, checks at every stage

claude.label: Fable at xhigh effort
claude.suited_for: the ceiling: a problem that defeated Opus at xhigh, a production failure from fragmented evidence, research-grade design, a final review before a critical release

codex.label: Luna at low effort
codex.suited_for: local, deterministic, well-specified edit with a cheap check: rename, docstring, formatting, a one-line fix; nothing ambiguous or critical

codex.label: Sol at low effort
codex.suited_for: small routine component following an existing pattern, with a few API or layout decisions: an endpoint, a join query, a test, pagination

codex.label: Sol at medium effort
codex.suited_for: end-to-end feature across modules with predictable contract tests

codex.label: Sol at high effort
codex.suited_for: integration with failures or concurrency: reproduce the failure first; retries, shared state, async changes without breaking contracts

codex.label: Astra at medium effort
codex.suited_for: architectural review or multi-cause diagnosis across layers where more than one solution is viable

codex.label: Astra at high effort
codex.suited_for: critical systems and invariants: large regression risk, several hypotheses, strong evidence required

codex.label: Astra at xhigh effort
codex.suited_for: complex decisions with deep trade-offs under incomplete specifications and failure scenarios

codex.label: Astra at max effort
codex.suited_for: exceptionally hard, high-impact investigation after Astra at xhigh fell short; diminishing returns and prone to overthinking
